56
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, August 5, 2015/Sravana 14, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Mines; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Steel; Tourism;
Tribal Affairs; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 15
Enhancing strategic crude oil storage
capacity
*166. SHRI A.U. SINGH DEO: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has been
proposing to enhance the strategic crude
oil storage capacity during the Twelfth Five
Year Plan, if so, the details in this regard;
(b) the details of the funds allocated
and so far released for the said purpose
during the current Plan period;
(c) the present storage capacity of
crude oil and the extent to which it is likely
to be enhanced during the current Plan
period; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
complete the Plan targets and enhance the
storage capacity of crude oil to meet
emergent requirement of the country?
Status of missing children in the
country
*167. SHRI BAISHNAB PARIDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) what is the existing status of missing
children in the country including the
percentage of recovery of such children and
their restoration to their parents;
(b) whether the Apex Court has issued
some direction on the poor status of
recovery of such children in the country, if
so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether it is proposed to frame new
effective rules to control this menace, if so,
the details thereof?
Registered unemployed persons in the
country
*168. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of LABOUR AND
EMPLOYMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise total number of
registered unemployed persons in the
country at present;
(b) whether employment opportunities
have not increased in the country in the
recent years; and
(c) if so, the sector-wise details of targets
fixed and achieved for employment
generation during 2014-15?

57
Impact of cheap imports on domestic
paper industry
*169. SHRI D. KUPENDRA REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that rise in cheaper
imports threatens fresh investments in the
paper industry of the country; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken/being taken to protect the domestic
players of paper industry?
Unnatural deaths in Vyapam Scam
*170. SHRI T.K. RANGARAJAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as many as
25 witnesses and accused persons have died
unnatural deaths since V yapam Scam came
to light in 2013; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Poor condition of SAI hostels
*171. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether some hostels of Sports
Authority of India (SAI) centres set up in
various parts of the country are in very
dilapidated condition and numerous
complaints are received regarding the
unhygienic rooms/toilets, poor quality food
provided for the athletes in SAI hostels;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto, the details of action taken by
Government against the authorities/officials
responsible for the same, if not, the reasons
therefor;
(c) the complaint redressal and
monitoring mechanism existing with
Government for addressing such issues; and
(d) the action/steps taken by
Government to develop SAI hostels across
the country?
Setting up of spice development
agencies
*172. DR. K.V.P. RAMACHANDRA
RAO: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
to set up spice development agencies to
give a push to spices exports, if so, the
details thereof; and
(b) whether Government will consider
setting up such agencies in Andhra Pradesh
or Telangana since both States produce a
variety of spices?
Challenges faced by tourism industry
*173. SHRI AAY ANUR
MANJUNATHA: Will the Minister of
TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) the details of various challenges/
issues/problems being faced by the tourism
industry;
(b) the steps taken/being taken by the
Ministry to solve these issues; and
(c) the measures taken by Government
for generation of additional employment
during the Twelfth Five Year Plan to help
in resolving issues relating to tourism
industry?
Illegal constructions around
Humayun's Tomb
*174. SHRI PALV AI GOVARDHAN
REDDY: Will the Minister of CULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Archaeological Survey of
India (ASI) has given permission to a
number of real estate operators to build
new structures around the UNESCO
recognized Humayun's Tomb in Delhi in
the last three years;
(b) if so, the details of permissions given
by ASI in 2013-14 and 2014-15 and the
current year;

58
(c) whether it is a fact that the ASI has
agreed to regularize all such illegal
constructions around the Tomb for
payment of a token fee;
(d) if so, the total fees collected and

411
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, August 5, 2015/Sravana 14, 1937 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Home Affairs; Labour and
Employment; Mines; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Steel; Tourism;
Tribal Affairs; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 160
New initiatives to attract foreign
investment
1761. SHRI TARUN VIJAY: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the new initiatives by the Ministry
to attract foreign investment and help
increase ease to do business in India; and
(b) the results of such initiatives in
terms of Foreign Direct Investment (FDI)
and accelerating domestic industrial
growth?
Industrial Development Centres in
Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and Maharashtra
1762. SHRIMATI RAJANI PATIL:
SHRI KIRANMAY NANDA:
SHRI K.C. TYAGI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Industrial
Development Centres opened in the
country including the number of such
centres opened in Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and
Maharashtra during the last two years;
(b) the amount of funds provided by
Government for Industrial Development
Centres in the States during last two years;
and
(c) the number of such centres likely to
be opened in future?
SEZs operational in the country
1763. SHRI PRAMOD TIWARI:
SHRI K.C. TYAGI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the State-wise number of Special
Economic Zones (SEZs) operational in the
country, at present;
(b) how many SEZs are in the pipeline
and by when these are expected to become
operational;
(c) what tax advantages are being given
to SEZ units; and
(d) how much tax would have been
collected by Government if these
advantages/concessions/benefits would not
have been given?

412
Increase in FDI cap in some sectors
1764. SHRI VIJAY GOEL: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
increase the Foreign Direct Investment
(FDI) cap in some sectors;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and the
details of present FDI limit in various
sectors?
Preferential treatment by Iran to
Indian investors
1765. SHRI K.R. ARJUNAN: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Iran promises
preferential treatment to Indian investors;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Outflow/inflow of FDI
1766. SHRI JESUDASU SEELAM:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether there has been any outflow
or inflow of foreign investment in general
and Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) in
particular to and from the 18 countries
which the Prime Minister visited in  last
one year;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) what has been the value of FDI
inflow to India from France and Germany
in last one year; and
(d) whether there has been any
agreement or MoU signed between India
and France and India and Germany in last
one year and if so, the details thereof?
Sluggish exports to Asian countries
1767. SHRI ANIL DESAI: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian exports to Asian
countries have been sluggish over the last
three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) what steps Government is taking to
step up exports to those countries
particularly in the backdrop of the Prime
Minister's recent visit to those countries
and signing several bilateral agreements?
Import of cheaper tyres
1768. SHRI K.N. BALAGOPAL: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has noticed the
huge import of automobile tyres from
different countries with very low price
compared to Indian products; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor?
Growth of organised manufacturing
production
1769. DR. BHALCHANDRA
MUNGEKAR: Will the Minister of
COMMERCE AND INDUSTRY be
pleased to state:
(a) what was the rate of growth of
organised manufacturing production during
the last three years ending 31st March,
2015;
(b) what steps were taken to enhance
this rate of growth;
(c) what impact did these steps have on
the performance of the manufacturing
sector; and

413
(d) what steps are planned for the next
two to three years?
Ranking of India in Doing Business
Report
1770. SHR VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware of
India's falling ranking in the Ease of Doing
Business Report, which is 142 among 189
countries if so, the last five years' rankings
and the reasons for such falling;
(b) whether Government refutes the
finding that India occupies the 142nd place;
(c) the number of total clearance
required to start functioning of an industry
along with number of State clearances
required by the Centre; and
(d) whether Government is planning to
build a policy to enhance the ease of doing
business in India?
S
